evidence: spectrum_integral is true with 5 distinct eigenvalues (715, 55, 1, -10, -220), consistent with a Kneser graph K(n,k) with k = 4 having k+1 = 5 eigenvalues
greedy lower bound 560 vs clique_cover upper 627

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 560 for the 2380-receiver graph. Lower bound: an independent set of size 560 (check passed). Upper bound: a linear code M = I + 2A over F_3 of length 560 that fits the graph, with factorization and decoding checks passed. One code was tried, after 1 critic round. Against the baselines: CP-SAT found alpha = 560 but did not prove it in about 125 s, CP-SAT cover found nothing, the fractional cover gave 2368 (unproven), and the F_2 minrank SAT only reached a lower bound of 559. All of them lose to the agent. The kushagra_agent baseline also proved 560 (field 3), and it did so in 2.3 s, while this agent took 33.2 s wall. Of that, 31.4 s was LLM time and only 1.8 s was compute, so on time it is a clear loss. Nothing looks suspicious.
